Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished, realistic desktop web UI reference for Platforma Market, a Russian-language B2B dental marketplace. Image 1 is the existing application screenshot: use it as the visual reference and preserve its compact white header, 200px white left sidebar, logo centered on the same horizontal axis as the page title, thin aligned bottom border, emerald green accents, pale mint-gray content background, readable restrained sans-serif typography, rounded bordered white cards, Fluent-style outlined icons. Full screen flat screenshot, no device mockup, no perspective, no exterior framing. Render at high resolution landscape about 1440x1000; every label legible. Keep 24px spacing, 44px accessible controls. Header right: small notification bell and green circular employee avatar. Sidebar footer anchored bottom: 'Поддержка' then 'Настройки'. Do not add employee/role management, tariffs, billing, integrations, marketing, fake graphs, AI features, or invented settings. These are future visual concepts, not production screenshots. Use only clearly fictional example data. No extra banners explaining implementation or technical APIs.
Screen: supplier 'Настройки организации'. Sidebar main links: 'Главная', 'Товары', 'Заказы', 'Документы', 'Сообщения'; bottom 'Настройки' selected pale green. Main page has a compact horizontal tab strip: 'Организация' selected, 'Склады', 'Источники товаров'. Show the Organization tab with a clean practical form, not a dashboard. Top white section 'Данные организации', two read-only fields 'Юридическое название' with 'ТОО «Демо Снабжение»' and 'БИН' with '000000000001'. Next section 'Рабочие контакты': input labels 'Контактное лицо', 'Телефон организации', 'Электронная почта организации'; sample values 'Контакт для заказов', '+7 (___) ___-__-__', 'office@example.invalid'. Lower section 'Юридический адрес': fields 'Город', 'Адрес', 'Почтовый индекс', city 'Алматы', address placeholder 'Укажите адрес'. Include a compact 'Адрес получения' subsection with same three fields; it is not a warehouse. Rightmost or bottom clearly aligned primary button 'Сохранить изменения' and secondary 'Отмена'. Keep a small amount of empty breathing space. Tabs communicate existing additional supplier domains but do NOT invent global delivery conditions or automatic external connections. No employee personal data and no role list. All UI copy in accurate Cyrillic Russian.
